categories.main_business_segments: Great Wall Motor Company Limited primarily engages in the design, research and development, manufacturing, and sale of automobiles including SUVs, sedans, pickup trucks, MPVs, motorcycles, and automotive parts and components. The company operates multiple brands such as Haval, WEY, TANK, GWM Pickup, ORA, and GWM SOUO, covering various vehicle categories and powertrain types including traditional engines and new energy systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on intelligent new energy vehicle technologies, including intelligent cockpit systems (Coffee OS 3), intelligent driving systems (Coffee Pilot Ultra), and hybrid powertrain architectures (Hi4, Hi4-T, Hi4-Z). It develops automotive-grade chips (RISC-V based Zijing M100), advanced battery technologies (ternary, lithium iron phosphate, sodium-ion, solid-state), and high-power ultra-fast charging platforms. Manufacturing integrates traditional and new energy vehicle production lines with a strong emphasis on quality and innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Great Wall Motor serves a broad customer base including individual consumers and commercial users in the automotive market, with a focus on domestic Chinese customers and expanding overseas markets. Its products cater to urban, off-road, and niche segments such as women-focused electric vehicles (ORA) and high-end intelligent new energy vehicles (WEY). The company is not dependent on any single major customer, with diversified sales across domestic and international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with extensive domestic manufacturing and sales. It has a significant and growing overseas presence with sales networks covering over 170 countries and regions, including Southeast Asia, Latin America, Africa, Europe, the Middle East, Australia, and South Africa. It has established manufacturing bases in Thailand, Brazil, and KD factories in Ecuador, Pakistan, and other locations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Great Wall Motor operates as an integrated automotive manufacturer with vertical integration in core components such as powertrains, chassis, intelligent cockpit hardware and software, and future energy industry chains. It maintains a forest-like ecosystem with over 500 ecosystem partners in AI, chip design, manufacturing, and Internet of Vehicles, ensuring supply chain stability and cost efficiency.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes intelligent new energy vehicle development, focusing on intelligent driving, smart cockpits, AI data intelligence, and computing power. It invests heavily in R&D with over RMB10 billion spent in 2024, emphasizing breakthroughs in hybrid architectures, battery technologies, and hydrogen fuel cell systems. The globalization strategy aims to expand product offerings and market presence worldwide, supported by localized R&D and production capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of automobiles and automotive parts and components. The company also earns income from labor services and other related automotive services. It benefits from government grants and subsidies related to new energy vehicles. Financial income includes gains from investments and fair value changes of financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Great Wall Motor positions itself as a leading Chinese automotive manufacturer with a strong focus on SUVs and new energy vehicles. It is recognized as a global SUV expert through its Haval brand and a leader in off-road and intelligent new energy vehicles with its TANK and WEY brands. The company competes in both domestic and international markets, leveraging technological innovation and ecosystem globalization to differentiate itself.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Great Wall Motor achieved total operating revenue of RMB202.2 billion, a 16.73% increase year-on-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB12.69 billion, an 80.76% increase. The company sold 1,234,500 vehicles globally, with overseas sales growing 44.61%. It employs approximately 84,915 employees and maintains a strong asset base of over RMB217 billion with steady growth in profitability and operational scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Great Wall Motor emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced vehicles with a focus on intelligent driving, smart cockpits, and new energy solutions. Its forest-like ecosystem and vertical integration enable cost-effective innovation and quality assurance. The company offers diversified product portfolios tailored to various user scenarios, including urban, off-road, and niche markets, supported by a comprehensive global localization strategy to deliver superior user experiences and sustainable growth.
